en: This is a vintage postcard depicting a broad avenue lined with trees and stately buildings, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century. The foreground features an obelisk or small monument and a prominent multi-story building with classical architectural elements. The caption on the image is in Bulgarian, English, and French, translating as 'Varna. Rue Vladislav.' The reverse side features handwritten Cyrillic script covering most of the card, a purple stamp, and printed text referencing a bookseller from Varna.
